summary: Configured and verified persistent routed eBGP transit through SONiC. Both endpoint routes exchange correctly, forwarding preserves source addresses, and management BGP access is blocked.
actions_performed: Configured node1 SONiC data links and AS65100 FRR peers.
Configured node2 AS65101 and node3 AS65102 with persistent endpoint /32s and exact prefix filters.
Enabled kernel forwarding only where required and installed persistent nftables security policies without NAT.
Added enabled boot-time services/networkd configuration for interface, firewall, and SONiC BGP recovery.
Verified both BGP sessions are Established, each peer advertises exactly one endpoint route, and bidirectional endpoint pings succeed with original sources.
